content.question: Which clustering algorithm can explicitly label points that belong to no cluster, and what are such points called?
options: K-means - leftover points are called centroids.
Hierarchical clustering - leftover points are called leaves of the dendrogram.
K-means - leftover points are called border points.
DBSCAN - points that are neither core nor border points are called noise points.
content.answer: DBSCAN - points that are neither core nor border points are called noise points.
